scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Complex isolated hypersurface germs of the specified top-monomial form.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: No classification of all singularities with minimal Tjurina defect is claimed.
scientific_integrity.verification_basis: Explicit weighted-filtration and Euler-identity proof plus a reproducible Gröbner-basis count for one example.

scientific_limitations: The result is a construction for exponent tuples with \(m\ge6\) and reciprocal sum \(\sum_i1/a_i=2\), not a classification of all 1-liminal singularities.
The explicit Gröbner-basis replay checks the dimension-five example; the general formulas for \(\mu\) and \(\tau\) follow from the proof in RESULT.md.
Independent audit and external validation have not been performed.
title: Top-monomial deformations realize the minimal Tjurina defect at the 1-liminal boundary
